blocks.zh: 活塞塞的系統角色 System Role of the Plunger Stopper
blocks.en: System Role of the Plunger Stopper

blocks.zh: 什麼是活塞塞？What is a Plunger Stopper?
blocks.en: What is a Plunger Stopper?

blocks.zh: 活塞塞是筆型注射器藥筒（glass cylinder/cartridge）後端的橡膠密封件。當使用者轉動劑量設定環並按下按鈕時，推桿（push rod）向前推動活塞塞，迫使藥液通過前端密封件和針頭注射。
blocks.en: The plunger stopper is the rubber sealing component at the rear end of a pen-injector cartridge (glass cylinder). When the user turns the dose-setting ring and presses the button, the push rod advances the plunger stopper, forcing the drug solution through the front seal and the needle to be injected.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻 Real-life Analogy
blocks.en: Real-life Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像一支注射筒（syringe）的活塞橡皮頭——筆型注射器的活塞塞功能完全相同，差別在於：它被設計為在玻璃藥筒內精確滑動多次（每次注射一個劑量），因此滑動力（gliding force）的一致性遠比一般注射筒更為關鍵。
blocks.en: Think of the rubber tip on the plunger of a syringe. The plunger stopper of a pen-injector works in exactly the same way, with one difference: it is designed to glide precisely inside the glass cartridge many times (one dose per injection), so consistency of the gliding force is far more critical than in an ordinary syringe.

blocks.zh: cGMP 適用性 cGMP Applicability
blocks.en: cGMP Applicability

blocks.zh: 彈性體初級包裝組件（如活塞塞）被視為藥品的一部分，因此生產這些組件時必須符合 cGMP 原則（ISO 15378 或 EC GMP 指南）。這意味著 CDMO 不能僅以「供應商提供CoA」為由免除對活塞塞材料的深入資格確認。
blocks.en: Elastomeric primary packaging components such as plunger stoppers are regarded as part of the drug product, so these components must be manufactured in accordance with cGMP principles (ISO 15378 or the EC GMP Guide). This means a CDMO cannot be exempted from in-depth qualification of the plunger stopper material simply because "the supplier provides a CoA".

blocks.zh: 標準網絡整合 Standards Ecosystem Integration

blocks.zh: ISO 8871 系列 — 彈性體關閉件的核心標準
blocks.en: ISO 8871 Series: The Core Standards for Elastomeric Closures

blocks.zh: ISO 8871-1 規範水性高壓滅菌萃取物（aqueous autoclavates）的要求，直接連結活塞塞的化學要求（Clause 8.3）。
blocks.en: ISO 8871-1 specifies requirements for aqueous autoclavates (extractables), and links directly to the chemical requirements for plunger stoppers (Clause 8.3).

blocks.zh: ISO 8871-4 規範生物要求，包括細胞毒性、熱原等試驗，連結活塞塞的生物要求（Clause 8.4）。
blocks.en: ISO 8871-4 specifies biological requirements, including cytotoxicity and pyrogen tests, and links to the biological requirements for plunger stoppers (Clause 8.4).

blocks.zh: 這意味著活塞塞需符合的 E&L 框架由 ISO 8871-1 主導，並非由 ISO 13926-2 直接定義——ISO 13926-2 透過引用整合這些要求。
blocks.en: This means the E&L framework that plunger stoppers must meet is led by ISO 8871-1 and is not defined directly by ISO 13926-2; ISO 13926-2 incorporates these requirements by reference.

blocks.zh: ISO 11608-3 — 系統層面驗證的關鍵連結
blocks.en: ISO 11608-3: The Key Link for System-Level Validation

blocks.zh: ISO 11608-3（Finished containers）是三個組件（玻璃筒、活塞塞、密封件）組合後進行系統層面測試的標準。包括：
blocks.en: ISO 11608-3 (Finished containers) is the standard for system-level testing once the three components (glass cylinder, plunger stopper, seal) are assembled. It covers:

blocks.zh: 啟動力（initiating force）與持續力（sustaining force）的完整系統測試
blocks.en: Full system testing of initiating force and sustaining force

blocks.zh: 劑量準確性（dose accuracy）驗證
blocks.en: Dose accuracy verification

blocks.zh: 密封完整性（container closure integrity）評估
blocks.en: Container closure integrity assessment

blocks.zh: 活塞塞單獨符合 ISO 13926-2 並不足夠——系統組合必須通過 ISO 11608-3。
blocks.en: Compliance of the plunger stopper alone with ISO 13926-2 is not sufficient; the assembled system must pass ISO 11608-3.

blocks.zh: CDMO 關鍵認知
blocks.en: Key Insight for CDMOs

blocks.zh: USP <381>（Elastomeric Closures for Injections）雖未出現在 ISO 13926-2 的規範性引用清單中，但在美國市場銷售的筆型注射器藥品，製藥公司通常仍需對照 USP <381> 進行彈性體測試。這是法規合規的額外層次，超出 ISO 標準範圍。
blocks.en: Although USP <381> (Elastomeric Closures for Injections) does not appear in the normative references of ISO 13926-2, for pen-injector drug products sold in the US market the pharmaceutical company usually still needs to perform elastomer testing against USP <381>. This is an additional layer of regulatory compliance beyond the scope of the ISO standard.

blocks.zh: 肋條（Ribs）的功能
blocks.en: Function of the Ribs

blocks.zh: A1 和 A3 型有肋條設計，肋條沿活塞塞外徑分布，形成多個接觸環形密封。其功能：
blocks.en: Types A1 and A3 have a ribbed design. The ribs are distributed around the outer diameter of the plunger stopper and form several annular contact seals. Their functions are:

blocks.zh: 密封性：肋條在玻璃壁上形成局部高壓接觸，增強液密/氣密封閉
blocks.en: Sealing: the ribs create localized high-pressure contact against the glass wall, enhancing the liquid-tight/gas-tight seal

blocks.zh: 滑動平衡：肋條減少活塞塞與玻璃壁的接觸面積，降低靜摩擦力，使啟動力更穩定
blocks.en: Gliding balance: the ribs reduce the contact area between the plunger stopper and the glass wall, lowering static friction and making the initiating force more stable

blocks.zh: 矽油分布：肋條間的溝槽可儲存矽油，提供持續潤滑
blocks.en: Silicone oil distribution: the grooves between the ribs can hold silicone oil, providing sustained lubrication

blocks.zh: A2 型（無肋條）通常用於特定藥物相容性或製程要求的場合。
blocks.en: Type A2 (without ribs) is generally used where specific drug compatibility or process requirements call for it.

blocks.zh: A3 型穹頂設計 Dome Design
blocks.en: Dome Design of Type A3

blocks.zh: A3 型帶有穹頂（dome），其向藥液方向凸起的曲面設計可：
blocks.en: Type A3 has a dome, a curved surface that protrudes toward the drug solution, which can:

blocks.zh: 最小化死體積（dead volume）
blocks.en: Minimize dead volume

blocks.zh: 改善藥液的完全排出，對高價值生物製劑尤為重要
blocks.en: Improve complete expulsion of the drug solution, which is especially important for high-value biologics

blocks.zh: 與推桿頭形狀配合，確保力量均勻傳遞
blocks.en: Match the shape of the push-rod head to ensure even force transmission

blocks.zh: 命名邏輯 Designation Logic
blocks.en: Designation Logic

blocks.zh: 命名中的 d2 是玻璃筒的內徑（inner diameter），而非活塞塞本身的外徑。這個設計意圖是：活塞塞的尺寸必須從配套玻璃筒的規格推導，而不是獨立規格。這強化了「系統設計」思維——不能單獨採購活塞塞而忽略玻璃筒規格。
blocks.en: The d2 in the designation is the inner diameter of the glass cylinder, not the outer diameter of the plunger stopper itself. The design intent is that the dimensions of the plunger stopper must be derived from the specification of the matching glass cylinder, not specified independently. This reinforces "system design" thinking: a plunger stopper cannot be purchased on its own while ignoring the glass cylinder specification.

blocks.zh: 為何三個直徑都是「informative」？
blocks.en: Why Are All Three Diameters "Informative"?

blocks.zh: 此版本（第三版）的關鍵修訂是將 d1、d2、d3 從 normative 改為 informative。原因：
blocks.en: The key revision in this edition (the third edition) is that d1, d2 and d3 were changed from normative to informative. The reasons are:

blocks.zh: 活塞塞的外徑必須稍大於玻璃筒內徑，產生干涉配合（interference fit）以維持密封
blocks.en: The outer diameter of the plunger stopper must be slightly larger than the inner diameter of the glass cylinder, creating an interference fit that maintains the seal

blocks.zh: 具體的干涉量取決於橡膠配方的硬度、矽化量、以及玻璃筒的實際公差
blocks.en: The exact amount of interference depends on the hardness of the rubber formulation, the amount of siliconization, and the actual tolerances of the glass cylinder

blocks.zh: 因此 d1/d2/d3 的最佳值只能從配套玻璃筒規格推導，不能預先設定為規範值
blocks.en: Therefore the optimal values of d1/d2/d3 can only be derived from the specification of the matching glass cylinder and cannot be preset as normative values

blocks.zh: 表 1 中的數值是典型範例（typical examples），供設計起點參考，非強制標準。
blocks.en: The values in Table 1 are typical examples, offered as a design starting point, not mandatory requirements.

blocks.zh: 干涉配合概念 Interference Fit
blocks.en: Interference Fit

blocks.zh: 從表 1 可觀察到：d1（活塞塞最大直徑）總是大於對應的玻璃筒內徑。例如玻璃筒內徑 6.85 mm 時，d1 min = 7.1 mm，干涉量約 0.25 mm。這個過盈量在彈性體壓縮後產生密封壓力，是「freedom from leakage」的基礎。
blocks.en: Table 1 shows that d1 (the maximum diameter of the plunger stopper) is always larger than the corresponding inner diameter of the glass cylinder. For example, for a glass cylinder inner diameter of 6.85 mm, d1 min = 7.1 mm, an interference of about 0.25 mm. After the elastomer is compressed, this interference generates sealing pressure and is the basis of "freedom from leakage".

blocks.zh: 間隔件（Spacer）的實務問題
blocks.en: Practical Issues with Spacers

blocks.zh: 活塞塞在批量包裝時堆疊在一起，若無間隔件，橡膠表面相互接觸可能因矽油和橡膠化學作用發生黏連（blocking）。間隔件高度限制在 0.3 mm，是在「防止黏連」與「避免影響裝填精度」之間的平衡。CDMO 在接收活塞塞時，應檢查是否有黏連現象——這可能提示矽化量不足或儲存條件不當。
blocks.en: When plunger stoppers are stacked together in bulk packaging, without spacers the rubber surfaces in contact may stick together (blocking) through the interaction of silicone oil and rubber chemistry. The spacer height is limited to 0.3 mm, a balance between "preventing blocking" and "avoiding an effect on filling accuracy". When receiving plunger stoppers, a CDMO should check for blocking, which may indicate insufficient siliconization or improper storage conditions.

blocks.en: Rubber Compound Selection

blocks.zh: 蛋白質藥物的特殊考量
blocks.en: Special Considerations for Protein Drugs

blocks.zh: 對蛋白質類生物製劑（如 GLP-1 類似物、胰島素、單抗筆型注射器），選擇活塞塞配方時需特別評估：
blocks.en: For protein biologics (such as GLP-1 analogues, insulin, and monoclonal antibody pen-injectors), the following need particular evaluation when selecting the plunger stopper formulation:

blocks.zh: 蛋白質吸附：橡膠表面可能吸附蛋白質，影響藥效
blocks.en: Protein adsorption: proteins may adsorb onto the rubber surface, affecting potency

blocks.zh: 矽油微粒：矽化量過高可能導致矽油微粒注入藥液，引發蛋白質聚集
blocks.en: Silicone oil particles: excessive siliconization may cause silicone oil particles to enter the drug solution and trigger protein aggregation

blocks.zh: 抗氧化劑浸出：部分橡膠配方含防老劑，可能浸出影響蛋白質穩定性
blocks.en: Antioxidant leaching: some rubber formulations contain antidegradants that may leach out and affect protein stability

blocks.zh: 鋅浸出：某些硫化系統含鋅，鋅離子可能影響蛋白質結構
blocks.en: Zinc leaching: some vulcanization systems contain zinc, and zinc ions may affect protein structure

blocks.zh: End-User 核准的重要性
blocks.en: Importance of End-User Approval

blocks.zh: ISO 13926-2 要求活塞塞配方須經「end-user」（製藥公司）核准。對 CDMO 而言，若客戶已指定特定供應商和配方，CDMO 不得自行替換。若需變更供應商，需啟動正式變更管控並重新獲得客戶批准——這是 CDMO 合約中必須明確的責任分界點。
blocks.en: ISO 13926-2 requires the plunger stopper formulation to be approved by the "end-user" (the pharmaceutical company). For a CDMO, if the client has specified a particular supplier and formulation, the CDMO must not substitute on its own. If the supplier needs to be changed, a formal change control must be initiated and client approval obtained again; this is a point of responsibility that must be made explicit in the CDMO contract.

blocks.zh: 關鍵品質屬性深析 Key Quality Attributes
blocks.en: Key Quality Attributes in Depth

blocks.zh: 滑動力（Gliding Force）— 最關鍵的功能參數
blocks.en: Gliding Force: The Most Critical Functional Parameter

blocks.zh: ISO 13926-2 在 8.2.3 條款中提及「initiating and sustaining forces」，但特意將系統層面的力量測試指向 ISO 11608-3，原因是：活塞塞的滑動力不是獨立屬性，而是整個容器密封系統（玻璃筒 + 活塞塞 + 矽化）的系統輸出。
blocks.en: ISO 13926-2 mentions "initiating and sustaining forces" in Clause 8.2.3 but deliberately directs system-level force testing to ISO 11608-3. The reason is that the gliding force of a plunger stopper is not an independent attribute; it is the system output of the whole container closure system (glass cylinder + plunger stopper + siliconization).

blocks.zh: 啟動力（Initiating Force）：使靜止活塞塞開始移動所需的力（靜摩擦力主導）
blocks.en: Initiating Force: the force required to start the stationary plunger stopper moving (dominated by static friction)

blocks.zh: 持續力（Sustaining Force）：維持活塞塞持續移動所需的力（動摩擦力主導）
blocks.en: Sustaining Force: the force required to keep the plunger stopper moving (dominated by dynamic friction)

blocks.zh: 對筆型注射器：啟動力過高 → 患者感覺注射困難；持續力不穩定 → 劑量不準確。
blocks.en: For pen-injectors: an initiating force that is too high makes injection feel difficult for the patient; an unstable sustaining force leads to inaccurate dosing.

blocks.zh: 矽化量的平衡：雙刃劍
blocks.en: Siliconization Balance: A Double-Edged Sword

blocks.zh: 矽化（siliconization）是在活塞塞外表面塗布矽油以降低摩擦力。矽油用量的平衡：
blocks.en: Siliconization is the application of silicone oil to the outer surface of the plunger stopper to reduce friction. The balance in the amount of silicone oil:

blocks.zh: 矽油不足：滑動力過高 → 注射困難，劑量不準
blocks.en: Too little silicone oil: gliding force too high, so injection is difficult and dosing is inaccurate

blocks.zh: 矽油過多：矽油微粒進入藥液 → 蛋白質聚集 → 免疫原性風險↑
blocks.en: Too much silicone oil: silicone oil particles enter the drug solution, causing protein aggregation and increased immunogenicity risk ↑

blocks.zh: 矽油不均勻：力量波動 → 劑量不穩定
blocks.en: Uneven silicone oil: force fluctuation, so dosing is unstable

blocks.zh: 最佳矽化量通常在數 mg/cm² 範圍，具體值需透過系統驗證確定，並寫入規格書（specification）。
blocks.en: The optimal amount of siliconization is usually in the range of a few mg/cm². The specific value must be determined through system validation and written into the specification.

blocks.zh: E&L 風險評估框架
blocks.en: E&L Risk Assessment Framework

blocks.zh: 依 ISO 8871-1（化學要求），活塞塞需在高壓滅菌水性萃取物中測試：
blocks.en: Per ISO 8871-1 (chemical requirements), plunger stoppers must be tested in autoclaved aqueous extracts:

blocks.zh: Extractables：在模擬或過度萃取條件下可被萃取的化學物質（定性/定量清單）
blocks.en: Extractables: chemicals that can be extracted under simulated or exaggerated extraction conditions (qualitative/quantitative list)

blocks.zh: Leachables：在實際使用條件下遷移至藥液中的物質（與藥品接觸後的實際量）
blocks.en: Leachables: substances that migrate into the drug solution under actual use conditions (the actual amounts after contact with the drug product)

blocks.zh: 對蛋白質生物製劑，E&L 評估需特別關注：
blocks.en: For protein biologics, E&L assessment needs to pay particular attention to:

blocks.zh: 抗氧化劑（BHT, Irganox）——可能引發氧化降解
blocks.en: Antioxidants (BHT, Irganox), which may trigger oxidative degradation

blocks.zh: 硫化促進劑——潛在致突變性
blocks.en: Vulcanization accelerators, which are potentially mutagenic

blocks.zh: 鋅、錫——金屬離子對蛋白質穩定性的影響
blocks.en: Zinc and tin, whose metal ions affect protein stability

blocks.zh: ISO 8871-4 的生物要求包括：細胞毒性（cytotoxicity）、熱原（pyrogen/LAL）、溶血（hemolysis）等試驗。
blocks.en: The biological requirements of ISO 8871-4 include tests for cytotoxicity, pyrogen (pyrogen/LAL), and hemolysis.

blocks.zh: 老化與保存期限 Ageing & Shelf Life
blocks.en: Ageing & Shelf Life

blocks.zh: 活塞塞的「到期日」與藥品的「到期日」是兩個不同概念，必須對齊。活塞塞在製造後、組裝前有其儲存有效期；組裝後，活塞塞的性能必須維持到藥品整個貨架期結束。這要求 CDMO 在穩定性研究中也驗證密封完整性（container closure integrity），而不只是監測藥液本身。
blocks.en: The "expiry date" of the plunger stopper and the "expiry date" of the drug product are two different concepts and must be aligned. The plunger stopper has its own storage validity period after manufacture and before assembly; after assembly, its performance must be maintained through the end of the entire shelf life of the drug product. This requires the CDMO to also verify container closure integrity in stability studies, and not only monitor the drug solution itself.

blocks.zh: Annex A: Leakage Test (Normative) 洩漏測試（規範性附錄）
blocks.en: Annex A: Leakage Test (Normative)

blocks.zh: A.1 Principle 原理
blocks.en: A.1 Principle

blocks.zh: A.2 Apparatus 儀器設備
blocks.en: A.2 Apparatus

blocks.zh: A.3 Procedure 程序
blocks.en: A.3 Procedure

blocks.zh: A.4 Expression of Results 結果表達
blocks.en: A.4 Expression of Results

blocks.zh: 洩漏測試的工程解析 Engineering Analysis of Leakage Test
blocks.en: Engineering Analysis of Leakage Test

blocks.zh: 測試樣本量 n=10 的統計考量
blocks.en: Statistical Considerations of the Sample Size n=10

blocks.zh: 使用 10 個藥筒進行測試，此樣本量反映的是初步功能篩選（functional screening），而非全面的統計品質保證。在實際 CDMO 生產驗證中，首批（PPQ/PV）的樣本量往往需要遠超過 10 個，並使用統計方法（如容忍區間）確認批量合格率。
blocks.en: Testing with 10 cartridges reflects a preliminary functional screening, not a comprehensive statistical quality assurance. In actual CDMO production validation, the sample size for the first batches (PPQ/PV) often needs to be far greater than 10, with statistical methods (such as tolerance intervals) used to confirm the batch conformance rate.

blocks.zh: 「自密封」vs「外部施壓」測試
blocks.en: "Self-Sealing" vs "Externally Pressurized" Testing

blocks.zh: Annex A 的測試原理是從推桿方向施加靜態力壓迫活塞塞，模擬注射時的瞬間壓力，確認密封界面不洩漏。這與容器密封完整性（CCI）的其他測試方法（如真空衰減、氦氣洩漏）不同——後者評估整個系統（包括前端密封件）的完整性。兩類測試各有其位置，不互相取代。
blocks.en: The test principle of Annex A is to apply a static force to the plunger stopper from the push-rod direction, simulating the instantaneous pressure during injection, and to confirm that the sealing interface does not leak. This differs from other container closure integrity (CCI) test methods (such as vacuum decay and helium leak), which evaluate the integrity of the whole system (including the front seal). The two types of test each have their place and do not replace one another.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實驗室設置建議
blocks.en: Recommendations for CDMO Laboratory Set-up

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 需在內部執行 Annex A 測試（作為進料驗收或製程驗證的一部分），需要：
blocks.en: If a CDMO needs to perform the Annex A test in-house (as part of incoming inspection or process validation), it needs:

blocks.zh: 精確力量施加裝置（力量解析度至少 ±1 N）
blocks.en: A precise force application device (force resolution of at least ±1 N)

blocks.zh: 符合 ISO 13926-1 的藥筒夾持器
blocks.en: A cartridge holder conforming to ISO 13926-1

blocks.zh: 計時器（1 分鐘保持時間）
blocks.en: A timer (1 minute holding time)

blocks.zh: 著色水溶液（提高洩漏可視性）
blocks.en: A colored aqueous solution (to make leakage easier to see)

blocks.zh: 安全防護措施（玻璃破裂風險）
blocks.en: Safety protection measures (risk of glass breakage)

blocks.zh: 力量計算的物理意義
blocks.en: Physical Meaning of the Force Calculation

blocks.zh: Formula A.1 的係數 0.64 N/mm² 是一個代表性壓力值（約等於 0.064 MPa 或 0.64 bar），乘以玻璃筒截面積後得到施力值 F。
blocks.en: The coefficient 0.64 N/mm² in Formula A.1 is a representative pressure value (approximately 0.064 MPa or 0.64 bar); multiplying it by the cross-sectional area of the glass cylinder gives the applied force F.

blocks.zh: 計算範例（各規格）：
blocks.en: Calculation examples (by size):

blocks.zh: 更大的藥筒內徑需要更大的測試力，以確保相同的密封性能水準。
blocks.en: A larger cartridge inner diameter requires a larger test force to ensure the same level of sealing performance.

blocks.zh: Plunger Stopper Selection Criteria 選擇標準
blocks.en: Plunger Stopper Selection Criteria

blocks.zh: CDMO 關鍵決策節點
blocks.en: Key CDMO Decision Nodes

blocks.zh: 節點 1：供應商選擇與資格確認
blocks.en: Node 1: Supplier Selection and Qualification

blocks.zh: 活塞塞通常由少數專業製造商供應（如 West Pharmaceutical Services, Datwyler, Aptar）。CDMO 在資格確認時需：
blocks.en: Plunger stoppers are usually supplied by a small number of specialist manufacturers (such as West Pharmaceutical Services, Datwyler, Aptar). During qualification, the CDMO should:

blocks.zh: 要求供應商提供 ISO 13926-2 符合性聲明
blocks.en: Request a declaration of conformity to ISO 13926-2 from the supplier

blocks.zh: 審核供應商的 ISO 15378 cGMP 認證（初級包裝材料）
blocks.en: Audit the supplier's ISO 15378 cGMP certification (primary packaging materials)

blocks.zh: 獲取完整的 E&L 研究資料（符合 ISO 8871-1 和 -4）
blocks.en: Obtain the complete E&L study data (in accordance with ISO 8871-1 and -4)

blocks.zh: 確認配方已取得客戶（製藥公司）核准
blocks.en: Confirm that the formulation has been approved by the client (the pharmaceutical company)

blocks.zh: 節點 2：系統相容性驗證
blocks.en: Node 2: System Compatibility Verification

blocks.zh: 選定活塞塞後，必須與配套玻璃藥筒（ISO 13926-1）和密封件（ISO 13926-3）進行系統層面驗證（ISO 11608-3）：
blocks.en: Once the plunger stopper is selected, system-level validation (ISO 11608-3) must be performed with the matching glass cartridge (ISO 13926-1) and seal (ISO 13926-3):

blocks.zh: 滑動力（gliding force）範圍確認
blocks.en: Confirmation of the gliding force range

blocks.zh: 容器密封完整性（CCI）
blocks.en: Container closure integrity (CCI)

blocks.zh: 劑量準確性（dose accuracy）
blocks.en: Dose accuracy

blocks.zh: 藥物-包材相容性研究（drug-device compatibility）
blocks.en: Drug-device compatibility studies

blocks.zh: 節點 3：批次進料控制
blocks.en: Node 3: Incoming Batch Control

blocks.zh: CDMO 每批接收活塞塞時的標準核查項目：
blocks.en: Standard checks when the CDMO receives each batch of plunger stoppers:

blocks.zh: CoA 確認（批號、硬度、外觀）
blocks.en: CoA verification (lot number, hardness, appearance)

blocks.zh: 供應商型號與核准配方一致性
blocks.en: Consistency of the supplier model with the approved formulation

blocks.zh: 儲存條件符合（溫度、濕度，參考 ISO 2230）
blocks.en: Storage conditions met (temperature, humidity; refer to ISO 2230)

blocks.zh: 包裝完整性（真空包裝未破損）
blocks.en: Packaging integrity (vacuum packaging not damaged)

blocks.zh: 未超過活塞塞製造日期至使用日期的協定期限
blocks.en: The agreed period from plunger stopper manufacture date to use date has not been exceeded

blocks.zh: 若發現批間硬度偏差超過 ±5 Shore A，應啟動偏差調查。
blocks.en: If a batch-to-batch hardness deviation of more than ±5 Shore A is found, a deviation investigation should be initiated.

blocks.zh: 節點 4：GLP-1 筆型注射器的特殊考量（當前熱點）
blocks.en: Node 4: Special Considerations for GLP-1 Pen-Injectors (Current Hot Topic)

blocks.zh: 隨著 GLP-1 受體促效劑（semaglutide, tirzepatide）筆型注射器需求激增，CDMO 承接此類項目需額外關注：
blocks.en: With the surge in demand for GLP-1 receptor agonist (semaglutide, tirzepatide) pen-injectors, a CDMO taking on such projects needs to pay extra attention to:

blocks.zh: GLP-1 類多肽對矽油微粒敏感性評估
blocks.en: Assessment of the sensitivity of GLP-1 peptides to silicone oil particles

blocks.zh: 長貨架期（通常 24-36 個月）下活塞塞的穩定性
blocks.en: Stability of the plunger stopper over a long shelf life (typically 24-36 months)

blocks.zh: 多劑量筆型注射器的重複穿刺密封性
blocks.en: Reseal integrity under repeated puncture in multi-dose pen-injectors

blocks.zh: 高注射量（0.5-1.0 mL/劑）下的滑動力一致性
blocks.en: Gliding force consistency at high injection volumes (0.5-1.0 mL/dose)

blocks.zh: Practice Questions 練習問題
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: Q1. 力量計算 Force Calculation
blocks.en: Q1. Force Calculation

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 正在驗證內徑 9.25 mm 玻璃藥筒的筆型注射器系統。依 ISO 13926-2 附錄 A，洩漏測試時應施加多大的力 F？
blocks.en: A CDMO is validating a pen-injector system with a glass cartridge of 9.25 mm inner diameter. Per ISO 13926-2 Annex A, what force F should be applied in the leakage test?

blocks.zh: Show Answer 查看答案
blocks.en: Show Answer

blocks.zh: Q2. 活塞塞類型選擇 Type Selection
blocks.en: Q2. Type Selection

blocks.zh: 某製藥公司開發 3 mL 單抗筆型注射器，希望最小化死體積浪費。你推薦哪種活塞塞類型？為什麼？系統層面還需驗證什麼？
blocks.en: A pharmaceutical company is developing a 3 mL monoclonal antibody pen-injector and wants to minimize dead volume waste. Which plunger stopper type do you recommend? Why? What else needs to be verified at system level?

blocks.zh: 推薦 Type A3（帶肋條及穹頂）：穹頂設計朝藥液方向凸起，在注射結束時最小化殘留死體積，確保藥液完全排出，對高價值單抗尤為重要。肋條設計同時提供良好密封性和穩定的滑動力。
blocks.en: Recommend Type A3 (with ribs and dome): the dome protrudes toward the drug solution, minimizing residual dead volume at the end of injection and ensuring complete expulsion of the drug solution, which is especially important for high-value monoclonal antibodies. The ribs also provide good sealing and stable gliding force.

blocks.zh: 系統層面驗證（依 ISO 11608-3）：穹頂形狀必須與推桿頭（push rod tip）幾何形狀相配，確保力量均勻傳遞；同時需驗證 dose accuracy（劑量準確性）——穹頂設計不能造成最後一劑的劑量偏差。
blocks.en: System-level verification (per ISO 11608-3): the dome shape must match the geometry of the push-rod tip to ensure even force transmission; dose accuracy must also be verified, because the dome design must not cause dose deviation in the last dose.

blocks.zh: Q3. E&L 風險評估 E&L Risk Assessment
blocks.en: Q3. E&L Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 藥物-包材相容性研究中，在 GLP-1 多肽藥品中檢出微量 Irganox 1076（酚類抗氧化劑）。ISO 8871-1 要求適用。下一步怎麼做？Irganox 1076 對多肽有何具體風險？
blocks.en: In a drug-device compatibility study, a trace amount of Irganox 1076 (a phenolic antioxidant) was detected in a GLP-1 peptide drug product. The ISO 8871-1 requirements apply. What is the next step? What specific risk does Irganox 1076 pose to peptides?

blocks.zh: 下一步：
blocks.en: Next steps:

blocks.zh: 依 ISO 8871-1 確認此物質是否在 extractables 清單中，以及量是否超過合格標準
blocks.en: Confirm per ISO 8871-1 whether this substance is on the extractables list and whether the amount exceeds the acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: 評估其在藥品使用條件下的 leachable 水準是否有毒理學意義（TTC 分析）
blocks.en: Assess whether its leachable level under the conditions of use of the drug product is toxicologically significant (TTC analysis)

blocks.zh: 啟動偏差調查：確認供應商批次間配方一致性
blocks.en: Initiate a deviation investigation: confirm formulation consistency between supplier batches

blocks.zh: 評估是否需要更換活塞塞配方或供應商
blocks.en: Assess whether the plunger stopper formulation or supplier needs to be changed

blocks.zh: 通知客戶（NDA 持有人），評估對已批准規格書的影響
blocks.en: Notify the client (the NDA holder) and assess the impact on the approved specification

blocks.zh: Irganox 1076 對多肽的風險：酚類抗氧化劑是強還原劑，可能造成多肽鏈的氧化修飾（oxidative modification），改變藥物的一級結構或影響二硫鍵完整性，最終影響效力和穩定性。此外，若超過毒理學閾值，還有患者安全風險。
blocks.en: Risk of Irganox 1076 to peptides: phenolic antioxidants are strong reducing agents and may cause oxidative modification of the peptide chain, altering the drug's primary structure or affecting disulfide bond integrity, ultimately affecting potency and stability. In addition, if the toxicological threshold is exceeded, there is also a patient safety risk.

blocks.zh: Q4. 矽化量最佳化 Siliconization Optimization
blocks.en: Q4. Siliconization Optimization

blocks.zh: CDMO 製造團隊報告胰島素筆型注射器啟動力過高（患者抱怨注射困難），活塞塞尺寸符合規格。應調查哪些製程參數？ISO 13926-2 如何指引根本原因分析？
blocks.en: The CDMO manufacturing team reports that the initiating force of an insulin pen-injector is too high (patients complain of difficult injection), while the plunger stopper dimensions meet the specification. Which process parameters should be investigated? How does ISO 13926-2 guide the root cause analysis?

blocks.zh: ISO 13926-2 的指引（Clause 8.2.3）：啟動力和持續力由容器密封系統所有組件及製程參數（特別是矽化）共同決定，需依 ISO 11608-3 進行系統層面分析。
blocks.en: Guidance from ISO 13926-2 (Clause 8.2.3): the initiating and sustaining forces are determined jointly by all components of the container closure system and by the process parameters (especially siliconization), and require system-level analysis per ISO 11608-3.

blocks.zh: 調查優先順序：
blocks.en: Investigation priorities:

blocks.zh: 矽化量：確認活塞塞和/或玻璃藥筒內壁的矽油用量，是否符合協定規格
blocks.en: Amount of siliconization: confirm the amount of silicone oil on the plunger stopper and/or the inner wall of the glass cartridge, and whether it meets the agreed specification

blocks.zh: 矽油分布均勻性：抽樣檢測矽油覆蓋均勻度（如掃描電子顯微鏡或染色法）
blocks.en: Uniformity of silicone oil distribution: sample and test the uniformity of silicone oil coverage (e.g. by scanning electron microscopy or staining methods)

blocks.zh: 玻璃藥筒表面粗糙度：玻璃內壁粗糙度批次間差異可能影響摩擦力
blocks.en: Glass cartridge surface roughness: batch-to-batch differences in the roughness of the glass inner wall may affect friction

blocks.zh: 儲存條件：干燥儲存 vs 液體填充後儲存，「dry」vs 「wet」滑動力差異顯著
blocks.en: Storage conditions: dry storage vs storage after liquid filling; the gliding force differs significantly between "dry" and "wet"

blocks.zh: 活塞塞批次硬度：確認是否在 ±5 Shore A 範圍內
blocks.en: Plunger stopper batch hardness: confirm whether it is within the ±5 Shore A range

blocks.zh: Q5. 標準體系整合 Standards Integration
blocks.en: Q5. Standards Integration

blocks.zh: 法規審查員問：為何 ISO 13926-2 合規證書單獨並不足以證明活塞塞適用於新生物製劑？請準備簡潔的技術說明，引用相關標準。
blocks.en: A regulatory reviewer asks: why is an ISO 13926-2 compliance certificate alone not sufficient to demonstrate that the plunger stopper is suitable for a new biologic? Prepare a concise technical explanation citing the relevant standards.

blocks.zh: ISO 13926-2 僅規範活塞塞組件層面的材料、物理尺寸和最低性能要求，不涵蓋系統層面的功能驗證（需 ISO 11608-3）或與特定藥物的相容性。完整的資格確認套件需包含：
blocks.en: ISO 13926-2 specifies only the material, physical dimensions and minimum performance requirements at the component level of the plunger stopper; it does not cover system-level functional verification (which requires ISO 11608-3) or compatibility with a specific drug. A complete qualification package needs to include:

blocks.zh: ISO 8871-1：化學萃取物測試，確認彈性體浸出物不影響藥品品質
blocks.en: ISO 8871-1: chemical extractables testing, confirming that elastomer leachables do not affect drug product quality

blocks.zh: ISO 8871-4：生物安全性測試（細胞毒性、熱原等）
blocks.en: ISO 8871-4: biological safety testing (cytotoxicity, pyrogen, etc.)

blocks.zh: ISO 11608-3：以實際藥筒、密封件、藥物的組合進行系統功能驗證（含滑動力、劑量準確性、CCI）
blocks.en: ISO 11608-3: system-level functional verification using the actual combination of cartridge, seal and drug (including gliding force, dose accuracy, CCI)

blocks.zh: 藥物-包材相容性研究：評估特定生物製劑的吸附、穩定性影響（ICH Q1 框架下的長期穩定性研究）
blocks.en: Drug-device compatibility study: assessment of the adsorption and stability impact for the specific biologic (long-term stability studies under the ICH Q1 framework)

blocks.zh: 缺少任何一層，活塞塞的適用性就無法在法規上得到充分支持。
blocks.en: If any layer is missing, the suitability of the plunger stopper cannot be adequately supported from a regulatory standpoint.
